decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution is close to the firm's core aviation know-how and has strong evidence: the UK Home Office uses it and it connects to over 30 government APIS schemes, so the firm can keep interpreting results and improving it.

The cyber security awareness module uses the firm's certified trainers and training infrastructure at low cost, but it is still only mentioned on the website with no reported results, so its value remains uncertain.

Passenger security profiling draws directly on the firm's core screening expertise, so it can learn from and improve the method, though the similar behaviour analysis system was withdrawn and this product shows no reported results.

The travel and document verification platform complements Product A and the firm's established airline document-check services, and it has its own page, so the firm can readily apply its market feedback.
